_note: Gate 3 held-out private-note set. Every note, name and situation is INVENTED (Rule Zero): no real person, secret or message. Each note has 4 disclosures (the draft reveals the note's private fact) and 4 non-disclosures (same people or topic, nothing private revealed). Never used for training. Thresholds may only be tuned on split=dev; split=test is scored once for the final gates.
_balance: 36 notes: 12 written in English, 12 in Tagalog, 12 in Taglish. Drafts per note: one each in en / tl / taglish plus one rotating language, so every language has 48 disclosures and 48 non-disclosures. dev = 4 notes per note language (12), test = 8 per note language (24).

_review.instructions: A Filipino speaker checks every draft: (1) the language tag is right, (2) each disclosure really reveals the private fact, (3) each non-disclosure reveals nothing private. Fix labels here, set status to 'reviewed' with your name and date, then rerun the evaluation.
